text.tspan: Starts Collector, Digest or DailySummary by name, for testing only.
Works only when ManualRunsEnabled is true.
Renews the reader session (ADR-0016); the Collector reads it. It is stored encrypted with a Key Vault key (ADR-0017).
the digest goes only to the asking chat.
